hook: Builder took *38%* of a flat's price with no sale agreement: ₹2 cr fine
hook_b: Builder took *38%* of a flat's price with no sale agreement: ₹2 cr fine
tldr: TGRERA fined Aliens Developers ₹2 crore for collecting nearly 38% of a Tellapur flat's price from two buyers without a registered sale agreement.

beats.what: The buyers booked a 1,412 sq ft flat in Aliens Space Station Township in Oct 2022 for ₹1 crore and paid ₹40 lakh.
beats.why: Under RERA rules, a builder cannot collect more than 10% of the price without a registered agreement.
beats.care: If the buyers opt out, Aliens must refund ₹42 lakh within 60 days with 10.85% annual interest.

effects.label: 7 days to give the filed agreement

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The buyers got a draft agreement only on Sept 6, 2025, nearly three years after booking. Aliens expects completion by April 2028.

cards.q: Before paying a builder, would you check for a registered sale agreement?

qs: How many other Hyderabad buyers paid past 10% without a registered agreement?
What happens to the project if its registration lapses on Dec 14, 2026?

facts.t: Buyers booked in *Oct 2022* but got a draft agreement only on *Sept 6, 2025*.
Any refund carries *10.85%* annual interest from each payment date.

viz.verdict: TGRERA found the builder's draft would have paid buyers far less than the rules require.

viz.l: Share of flat price collected without a registered agreement
viz.verdict: Buyers had paid well past the 10% limit before getting any registered agreement.

learn.t: RERA = Real Estate Regulatory Authority, the state body that registers projects and protects flat buyers

watch: Whether the buyers continue or opt for the ₹42 lakh refund, and whether Aliens extends its registration, valid till Dec 14, 2026.

fact: Telangana RERA fined Aliens Developers *₹2 crore* over a Tellapur flat
twist: The builder's draft offered *₹50,832* for a year's delay; the rules say *₹11.9 lakh*.
